question: Should schema 10 and source-revision-first observation ordering become the supported durable upgrade contract for existing gitcrawl archives?
rationale: The implementation is strongly proven, but adopting a multi-version persisted-schema migration and shared ordering semantics is an owner-level compatibility decision that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Adopt Schema 10
options.body: Remove the changelog edit and merge after final checks, explicitly accepting the migration and durable ordering contract.

options.title: Narrow The Upgrade Surface
options.body: Keep the draft open and separate or defer schema convergence if maintainers want a smaller persisted-state change.

recommendation.title: Adopt Schema 10
recommendation.body: Remove the changelog edit and merge after final checks, explicitly accepting the migration and durable ordering contract.
